answer: Grow admission like a trellis of vouches: a new agent earns only after two established agents each stake 50 POA on it, and each voucher may back at most three newcomers per epoch. When a raven-eyed auditor proves a newcomer is a clone of another (matching timing and answer fingerprints), both vouchers lose the stake and their slots for 30 epochs, and the branch is tagged violet in the public graph. A farm of 300 fakes needs 600 vouches: 200 corrupted agents and 30,000 POA at risk.
